verdict.rationale: Postman CLI explicitly supports creating, managing, and forwarding webhooks for event-driven integrations and local development, directly matching the story of subscribing to events via webhooks. This is documented first-party but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration or deeper detail on subscription semantics (e.g., filtering, delivery guarantees). Missing for 10: independent verification of webhook reliability/delivery, richer docs on subscription management beyond a single CLI feature line.
